title: Card Stand Packs
description: Unpack and put down stands for decoration!
body:
Card Stand Packs is a mod that adds mob themed stands that can be displayed in Stand blocks! Find them by unpacking packs dropped by mobs and more!
# Recipe
Stands can be crafted like:

![Clear Stand Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/7oYP7J5.png)

And can be dyed into different colors like:

![Dye Stands](https://i.imgur.com/8EB1M4l.png)

# Card Stands
![Pride themed build](https://i.imgur.com/g8cviFl.png)

There are over 100 stands based on mobs, their variant, structures and more! Display them by right-clicking them onto a stand, and right-click them with empty hand to flip them the other way.
# Packs
There are 36 packs in the mod, they are the way you get stands in this mod, each have their own way of dropping and different stands to collect.

![All Packs](https://i.imgur.com/VuAX8VS.png)

You can recraft stands back to the same pack if you get the same ones!

![Repack recipe](https://i.imgur.com/p7QR6Ru.png)

You'll need 3 stands that are from that pack, as well as an item responding to each pack.

# Reroll
For a higher chance of getting a pack, you can enchant your melee weapon with Reroll, allowing an extra chance for getting a pack when killing mobs, sometimes even getting double the drop!
